data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word 'Firdaws', meaning paradise or heaven. Firdausi is a name that symbolizes a person who embodies the beauty and blessings of paradise in their character and actions. The name Firdausi carries the meaning “Paradise Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Firdausi usually hope their child will grow to embody paradise garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Firdausi is deeply rooted in Persian culture and holds a significant place in Islamic history due to the works of the famous Persian poet, Abdul Qasem Firdausi. He is known for writing the Persian national epic, "The Book of Kings" (Shahnameh), which played a vital role in shaping Persian identity, pride, and heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic thought, the name Firdausi carries spiritual significance as it is derived from 'Firdaws', a name for heaven, which is paradise to Muslims. The name serves as a reminder of the spiritual journey towards attaining eternal bliss and nearness to Allah, inspiring individuals to strive for righteousness, self-improvement, and devotion. Hence, someone named Firdausi may aspire to embody the virtues of heaven, striving to live a wise, just and compassionate life.
